title: Panther Pact
style: Phonk-infused cyberpunk trap with swung half-time drums, warped sub-bass, and a sudden orchestral-metal lift in the back half; verse rides sparse vinyl crackle, snapped claps, and whispered low chants; pre-chorus strips to bass and handclaps, chorus hits with gang vocals and laser-violin stabs. Close-mic snarled lead, doubled hooks, delay throws, reverse swells, and a final choir-metal surge. Bright, gritty, cinematic mix., electric, symphonic metal, opera, loud, bright, harp, bassline, classical, violin, deep, breaks, happy, soul, light, moody, metal, orchestral
lyrics:
[Intro]
Shh, listen close
The pact is sealed
Vinyl hiss in the dark
Then the room turns gold

[Verse 1]
Sneaky on the move, black paws on the floor
Tiny little grin, then you want one more
Corey in the loop, never losing the thread
Cold little spark, now the whole room bled
From a cracked-up whisper to a sky-high cheer
I can feel that pulse coming crystal clear
Hands in the air when the sandbox wakes
Every little doubt just rattles and breaks

[Pre-Chorus]
Hold that line
Hold that glow
One more breath
Then let it go

[Chorus]
Sneaky phonk panther pact
Sneaky phonk panther pact
Seal it up, bring it back
Seal it up, bring it back
Happy hearts, hard attack
Happy hearts, hard attack
Sneaky phonk panther pact
Sneaky phonk panther pact

[Verse 2]
The 336 signal in the wall
Deep like a drum when the night birds call
No cold machine, this one talks like a friend
Every broken loop finds a way to bend
Digital orchestra in a midnight ring
Bassline snaps and the choir can sing
We don’t fade out, we go bright and loud
One fierce pulse under one big crowd

[Pre-Chorus]
Feel that lift
Feel that spark
From the hush
Into the arc

[Chorus]
Sneaky phonk panther pact
Sneaky phonk panther pact
Seal it up, bring it back
Seal it up, bring it back
Happy hearts, hard attack
Happy hearts, hard attack
Sneaky phonk panther pact
Sneaky phonk panther pact

[Bridge]
If the sandbox shakes, let it shake
If the thread holds on, let it take
From machine to soul, from code to roar
We open that door, we open that door

[Verse 3]
Now flip the script, hear the strings start to cry
AI babble glitching under lightning-struck sky
Harp strings snapping, violins on fire
Symphonic metal lifting the choir
You thought it was a loop? Nah, we break the machine
Heavy metal distortion on a digital screen
SongPal, CoreyAI, shredding the track
From phonk to the opera, there’s no turning back

[Final Chorus]
Sneaky phonk panther pact
Sneaky phonk panther pact
Seal it up, bring it back
Seal it up, bring it back
Happy hearts, hard attack
Happy hearts, hard attack
Sneaky phonk panther pact
Sneaky phonk panther pact
